items.q: The number of visitors fell sharply.
items.t: There was a dramatic drop in visitor numbers.
d: The number of visitors stayed the same.

note.ar: «fell sharply» = «dramatic drop». انتبه للمعنى لا للكلمات.

items.q: Most experts disagree with the theory.
items.t: The theory is rejected by the majority of specialists.
d: A few experts support the theory.
Experts have not studied the theory.

note.ar: most = the majority، disagree = reject.

items.q: The project was completed ahead of schedule.
items.t: The work finished earlier than planned.
d: The project cost more than expected.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: ahead of schedule = earlier than planned. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The drug has few side effects.
items.t: Unwanted reactions to the medicine are rare.

note.ar: few = rare، side effects = unwanted reactions.
note.en: few → rare; side effects → unwanted reactions.

items.q: Children learn languages more easily than adults.
items.t: Young learners pick up new languages with less effort.

note.ar: more easily = with less effort. «enjoy» مشتّت.

items.q: The museum is free for students.
items.t: Students do not have to pay to enter the museum.
d: Students get a discount at the museum.
The museum is popular with students.
Students can work at the museum.

note.ar: free = do not have to pay. الخصم ليس مجانًا.
note.en: free = no payment; a discount is not free.

items.q: The town relies heavily on tourism.
items.t: Tourism is vital to the town’s economy.
d: The town is trying to attract tourists.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: relies heavily on = is vital to. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The research was funded by a private company.
items.t: A business paid for the study.
d: The research was carried out by a company.

note.ar: funded by = paid for by. «carried out» = نفّذ، وليس موّل.
note.en: funded = paid for, not carried out.

items.q: Prices are expected to rise next year.
items.t: Costs will probably go up in the coming year.

note.ar: expected to = will probably؛ انتبه للزمن.
note.en: expected to = probably; watch the tense.

items.q: The new law was unpopular with farmers.
items.t: Farmers were unhappy about the new legislation.
d: Farmers asked for the new law.
Farmers did not know about the law.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: unpopular with = unhappy about. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The method is not suitable for small companies.
items.t: This approach does not work well for small businesses.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: not suitable = does not work well. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The bridge was built to replace a ferry service.
items.t: Before the bridge, people crossed by boat.
d: The ferry is still the main way to cross.
The bridge is older than the ferry.
The ferry was destroyed by a storm.

note.ar: replace a ferry = قبل الجسر كانوا يعبرون بالقارب.
note.en: Replacing a ferry implies people used boats before.

items.q: Few people were aware of the problem.
items.t: The issue went largely unnoticed.
d: Many people complained about the problem.
People ignored the problem on purpose.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: few were aware = went unnoticed. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The scheme has been extended for another year.
items.t: The programme will continue for twelve more months.
d: The scheme started a year ago.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: extended = will continue. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The decline began in the early twentieth century.
items.t: The fall started in the 1900s.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: early twentieth century = 1900s. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: Access to the beach is restricted in summer.
items.t: There are limits on entering the beach during the hot months.
d: The beach is closed all year.
The beach is crowded in summer.
The beach is free in summer.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: restricted = there are limits. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The results were similar in both groups.
items.t: There was little difference between the two groups.
d: The groups were very different in size.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: similar = little difference. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: Staff must wear identification at all times.
items.t: Employees are required to display their ID badge constantly.
d: Staff may wear ID if they want.
Staff must show ID at the entrance only.

note.ar: must = are required to؛ at all times = constantly.
note.en: must = are required to; at all times = constantly.

items.q: The writer doubts that the plan will succeed.
items.t: The author is sceptical about the plan’s chances.
d: The writer is confident about the plan.
The writer has not considered the plan.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: doubts = is sceptical. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The equipment is now outdated.
items.t: The machinery is no longer modern.

note.ar: outdated = no longer modern. «broken» = معطّل.

items.q: Rainfall has been below average for three years.
items.t: There has been less rain than usual since three years ago.
d: It has not rained for three years.

note.ar: below average ≠ لا مطر إطلاقًا.

items.q: The company is the largest employer in the region.
items.t: No other organisation in the area provides more jobs.
d: The company is the oldest in the region.
Most workers are unhappy at the company.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: largest employer = provides the most jobs. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.
note.en: largest employer = provides the most jobs.

items.q: The idea was first suggested in 1950.
items.t: The concept originated in the mid-twentieth century.
d: The idea is less than fifty years old.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: first suggested = originated. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: Students can borrow up to six books.
items.t: The maximum number of books a student may take out is six.
d: Students can borrow six books per day only.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: up to = maximum. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The festival attracts visitors from all over the world.
items.t: People travel internationally to attend the event.
d: Only local people go to the festival.
The festival travels around the world.
The festival is shown worldwide on TV.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: from all over the world = international visitors. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.
note.en: From all over the world = international visitors.

items.q: The experiment was repeated several times.
items.t: The test was carried out on a number of occasions.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: repeated several times = on a number of occasions. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.
note.en: repeated → carried out on several occasions.

items.q: Smoking is prohibited inside the building.
items.t: You are not allowed to smoke indoors.
d: There is a smoking area inside.
Smoking is allowed in some rooms.

note.ar: prohibited = not allowed. «discouraged» أضعف.

items.q: The population has doubled since 1990.
items.t: There are twice as many people now as in 1990.
d: The population has fallen by half.
The population grew by two per cent.

note.ar: إعادة الصياغة هنا: doubled = twice as many. — المعنى واحد بكلمات مختلفة.

items.q: The device is easy to carry.
items.t: It is portable.

note.ar: easy to carry = portable. «simple to use» معنى آخر.
note.en: easy to carry = portable (not easy to use).

items.q: Volunteers do most of the work.
items.t: The majority of the tasks are carried out by unpaid helpers.
d: Volunteers do some of the work.
Paid staff do most of the work.

note.ar: volunteers = unpaid helpers؛ most = the majority.
